summary.motive: Defeat slide protections and 6-man half-slide schemes by manufacturing instant interior penetration via an A-gap cross-dog twist while protecting the deep field with Hot coverage.
summary.keyDefender: LB_A2 (Looping A-gap crosser) & LB_A1 (Penetrating pick rusher)
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive linemen cannot pass off crossing rushers when both start aligned directly in their face pre-snap.
summary.failureMode: Quick seam route between the two deep safeties if the quarterback releases before the loop arrives.

beats.title: Mugged A-Gap Cross-Dog Twist
beats.text: Flores shows the identical 7-man psycho mug front before unleashing a 6-man overload fire blitz with a synchronized interior A-gap Cross-Dog stunt.

beats.title: Center Picking Wrong Rusher
beats.text: LB_A1 crashes hard into the left A-gap, occupying the Center and left guard, while LB_A2 loops tightly behind his back toward the opposite A-gap.

beats.title: Clean Interior A-Gap Pressure
beats.text: With the running back forced to pick up the strong C-gap rush, LB_A2 explodes completely unblocked through the vacated A-gap directly into the quarterback’s lap.

beats.title: Hurried Throw into Contested Flat
beats.text: Hit as he releases, the QB floats an off-balance throw toward the boundary flat, where LURKER has dropped into the hot passing lane to swat it away.

relations.tell: Inside linebackers cross through opposite A-gaps on a delayed twist stunt behind edge contain.
